x-e-m2-05.s.s1.prompt: Daataan tokko tokkoon ifa ba'a. Tarkaanfii hundaatti, wanta hanga ammaa beekamu qofa fayyadamuun murtee isa caalaa simatu filadhu.

x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Waliin jijjiiramuu fi sababa ta'uun adda dha.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Daawwannaa mana kitaabaa fi qabxiin waliin socho'u, garuu maaliif akka ta'e ammaaf hin beeknu.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Murteen kun hariiroo waliin socho'uu sababa irraa adda baasa.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Daawwannaan mana kitaabaa qabxii waliin hariiroo hin qabu.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Daataan hariiroon akka jiru agarsiisa. Hin jiru jechuun faallaa daataa dha.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.ask: Odeeffannoon kun yoo dabalame murteen kee akkamitti jijjiirama?
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Barattoonni yeroo baay'ee deeman amala biraa illee yoo qabaatan, mana kitaabaa moo amalli sun garaagarri qabxii uume adda baasuun ulfaata.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Sababoonni biroo, akka hojii manaa fi rafuu, qabxii fi daawwannaa lamaanuu ibsuu danda'u.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Murteen kun carraa ibsa biraa jiraachuu yaada.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Mana kitaabaan sababa ta'uun ifa ta'eera.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Odeeffannoon haaraan daataa jalqabaa hin kuffisu. Hiika qofa bal'isa.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Bu'aa qorannoo kanaan hima jalqabaa akkamitti madaalta?
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Gareen daawwate garee hin daawwanne wal-fakkaatuun qofa ol ba'e. Hima jalqabaa qorannoon kun hin deeggaru. Yeroon gabaabaa daangaa ta'uu isaa illee yaadachuu dandeessa.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Daawwannaan mana kitaabaa qabxii baay'ee guddisuu isaa mirkanaa'eera.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Jijjiiramni garee lamaanii wal-fakkaata, qabxii 1. Gareen daawwate baay'ee ol hin ba'ne.

x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Murteen kun jijjiirama garee lamaanii wal bira qabuu irraa dhufe.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Torban afur gabaabaa dha, kanaaf of eeggachuu qabna, garuu hima jalqabaa hin deeggaru.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Murteen kun daangaa bu'aa beeka garuu dubbiif bu'uura akka hin ta'in ilaala.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.reflect: Jalqaba 'waliin socho'u' qofa jechuu dandeessa ture. Odeeffannoo lammaffaa waliin, ibsi biraa mul'ate, fi qorannoo sadaffaa waliin, hima jalqabaa laafe. Odeeffannoon kam murtee kee jijjiire yaadi.

Hi Minho,
Let's plan our reading club meeting for next week.
1) We meet on a weekday, Monday to Friday, but not on Wednesday (I have a dentist visit) and not on Friday (the library closes early).
2) School ends at 3 p.m., so we can start at 3 p.m. at the earliest. The room can be used until 6 p.m.
3) The meeting takes two hours, and it always starts on the hour.
Please send me the days and start times that work.
Thanks, Hana
